title: Juicy Herbal Canadian Steak Kebabs
description: A nostalgic Canadian dish featuring sirloin steak tips, whisked with Mediterranean-friendly herbs, resulting in a juicy and flavorful meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, rosemary, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice.
Add the sirloin steak tips to the bowl and toss to coat with the herbal mixture.
Thread the steak tips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the steak reaches an internal temperature of 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh thyme and serve hot.
